name: Waffen Tag
summary:
Jump into an exciting VR world where movement, exploration, and multiplayer fun come together! This Gorilla Tag-inspired fan game lets you run, jump, climb, and move around using your arms as you explore different environments and interact with other players.

Practice your movement skills, discover new areas, challenge your friends, or simply hang out and have fun with the community. Whether you’re learning the basics or mastering fast and creative movement, there’s always something to do.
